verdict.rationale: A team knowledge workspace is a fair question for an AI coding assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents creating a shared workspace from docs and repos as a team source of truth. Skills (modular instruction sets), MCP data sources and Kanban worktrees are adjacent features and do not deliver that shared team workspace.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
